}} '''Landry Fields''' (born June 27, 1988) is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player who currently plays for the [[Stanford University]] [[Stanford Cardinal men's basketball|Cardinal]]. ==High school career== Fields attended [[Los Alamitos High School]] in [[Los Alamitos, California]]. Fields was a three-year letterwinner and captained his team during his junior and senior season.http://www.gostanford.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/fields_landry00.html Fields was also heavily recruited by [[Arizona Wildcats men's basketball|Arizona]] coach [[Lute Olson]] and by [[Gonzaga Bulldogs men's basketball|Gonzaga University]]. Fields ultimately chose to play for [[Trent Johnson]] and the [[Stanford University|Stanford]] [[Stanford Cardinal men's basketball|Cardinal]]. Fields joined [[Robin Lopez]] and [[Brook Lopez]] to create one of the top recruiting classes in the nation. http://rivals.yahoo.com/stanford/basketball/recruiting/commitments/2006 ==Collegiate career== Fields had an immediate impact for Stanford as a freshman, playing 14 minutes per game off the bench. Steadily improving his numbers every year, Fields went into his senior year as one of the top returning players in the Pac-10. Fields finished his senior season leading the [[Pac-10 Conference|Pac-10]] in scoring and rebounding, despite playing primarily as a [[shooting guard]] and [[small forward]]. His average of 22 points per game was also good enough for eighth in the nation overall in scoring. http://www.gostanford.com/sports/m-baskbl/mtt/fields_landry00.html == References == {{Reflist}} == External links == * [http://www.draftexpress.com/profile/Landry-Fields-5803/] [[Category:Articles created via the Article Wizard]]
